facts.fact: Egypt's National Cybersecurity Strategy 2023-2027 is published by the Supreme Cybersecurity Council and MCIT, and refers to the earlier 2017-2021 strategy; the document prints no date, so the date is the PDF creation date used as proxy.

systems.system: National Cybersecurity Authority / National Cybersecurity Center (planned under the strategy; its law is still a draft)

note: The strategy says the national cybersecurity centre is yet to be established and the cybersecurity law is in draft, so no body, response, designation or figures fact.
